literal: Eye-filling beauty, bamboo-resembling shoulders, to the innocent girl, woman-filled nature is great.
translation: This innocent girl with bamboo-like shoulders and eye-filling beauty possesses an abundance of deep feminine modesty.
modern: கண்களை நிறைக்கும் அழகும் மூங்கில் போன்ற தோள்களும் கொண்ட இந்தப் பேதைப் பெண்ணிடம், பெண்மைக்குரிய நாணம் முதலிய குணங்கள் மிகுதியாக உள்ளன.
explanation: The lover observes the heroine and notes that despite her overwhelming, eye-filling beauty and graceful bamboo-like shoulders, she remains an innocent girl. However, her 'womanly nature'—specifically her modesty and reserve—is very strong. This explains why she carefully conceals her romantic feelings behind a veil of traditional feminine restraint.
